title: 第一卷 第14章 好险，差点被卖了
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

净说些没用的屁话，想空手套白狼。

“丁婶子，你说什么呢，我跟萧大哥已经订婚了，我怎么能凭你一句话就要跟他分开。”

你到底能给我什么，你倒是说呀，要是给我个几万，多停一秒都是对钱的不尊重。

这是不见兔子不撒鹰。

丁桂兰心里暗骂一句季望棉难缠：“五十块钱，我可以给你五十块钱。”

乡下一年能攒个十块就算能干的了，五十绝对让她乖乖走人。

季望棉真是没时间给她唠穷嗑了，翻个白眼都算给对方甜头了。

“丁婶子你在说什么呢，什么五十块钱，我才不要你的钱，萧大哥的工资足够养家了。”

五十块钱你寒掺谁呢，萧临戍一个月的工资就是你的两倍了。

丁桂兰现在连萧临戍都怪上了，还没结婚呢就把工资说出来，真是蠢。

“三百。”

“萧大哥一辈子当团长我也不会离开他的。”

丁桂兰一咬牙：“六百，现钱！”

这是她目前能拿出来的所有活钱了。

季望棉有些失望，挺穷的！

换个方向吧！

“萧大哥当团长保护民众，我也不能闲着，我干点什么好呢，丁婶子你见多识广，你给我出个主意。”

丁桂兰的眼珠子都要掉出来了。

给钱不算，还得给工作？！

“你想做什么？”

季望棉才不会说。

“丁婶子，你也太客气了，你是太喜欢我了，所以要给我介绍工作吗？我有点受宠若惊呢！”

季望棉猛地回头，什么都没有，可是她好像听到了什么声音。

丁桂兰眯着眼，如果眼神能杀死人，季望棉现在已经千疮百孔了。

“我倒是对你的家庭很好奇，什么样的人才能养出你这么伶牙俐齿的人，说一句你能顶十句。”

“那我不如你，我说十句都没堵上你的嘴。”季望棉无辜地抿了抿唇：“丁主任，人家跟你说话，你怎么还偷偷数数呢，这样可不好，你要是专心肯定一句话就懂了。”

白费我那么多口水。

Page (1/3)

Just talk useless nonsense and try to gain nothing.

"Aunt Ding, what are you talking about? Brother Xiao and I are already engaged. How can I separate from him just by your words?"

What on earth can you give me? You want to say, if you give me tens of thousands, it would be disrespectful for money to wait for one second longer.

This is not letting go of the hawk without seeing the rabbit.

Ding Guilan secretly cursed Ji Wangmian for being difficult to deal with: "For fifty yuan, I can give you fifty yuan."

If you can save ten yuan a year in the countryside, you are considered a capable person. If you can save fifty yuan, she will definitely leave.

Ji Wangmian really didn't have time to nag her, so he could just roll his eyes and give her a favor.

"Aunt Ding, what are you talking about? Fifty yuan, I don't want your money. Brother Xiao's salary is enough to support the family."

Who do you want with fifty yuan? Xiao Linshu's monthly salary is twice yours.

Ding Guilan is now blaming Xiao Linshu. She is really stupid to reveal her salary before she is married.

"Three hundred."

"Brother Xiao will be the leader for the rest of his life and I will never leave him."

Ding Guilan gritted her teeth: "Six hundred, cash!"

This is all the living money she can currently afford.

Ji Wangmian was a little disappointed, he was quite poor!

Change the direction!

"Brother Xiao is the leader of the regiment to protect the people. I can't be idle. What should I do? Aunt Ding, you are well-informed. Please give me an idea."

Ding Guilan's eyes almost fell out.

Not only giving money, but also giving work?!

"What do you want to do?"

Ji Wangmian wouldn't say it.

"Aunt Ding, you are too polite. You like me so much that you want to introduce me to a job? I'm a little flattered!"

Ji Wangmian turned around suddenly, but there was nothing there, but she seemed to hear something.

Ding Guilan squinted her eyes. If eyes could kill, Ji Wangmian would be riddled with holes now.

"I'm very curious about your family. What kind of people can raise a person as smart as you? You can say one sentence ten times."

"Then I'm not as good as you. I couldn't silence you even if I said ten words." Ji Wangmian pursed her lips innocently: "Director Ding, when people are talking to you, why are you counting secretly? This is not good. If you concentrate on confirming a sentence, you will understand."

All my saliva was wasted.
